title: No Lugs No Masters: Romance is Dead by Crust Bikes
content:
The team at Crust Bikes has been working on developing some new frames, including a stripped-down, more utilitarian build of the Romanceur dubbed the Romance is Dead ($1,225). These frames have no lugs, save for the fork crown, and are all TIG-welded. Because of this simpler frame construction, they’re a little cheaper, too. They feature a slightly sloping top tube and have a more robust downtube than the previous Romanceur frames, while maintaining the same tire clearance and geometry as the Romeo. TL;DR, no lugs, no masters; Romance is Dead.

Check it out at Crust Bikes.
